reviewer: assistant actual image inspection through view_image
limits: Eight deliberately selected validation failures, CPU float32 re-render. Not exhaustive, not human review, not model/data acceptance approval.
observations: Visible wooden and white picket fence structures are present in RGB and GT; selected predictions mostly miss the fence and confuse it with background/wall/sidewalk. This is visible in Town04-00 and Town04-01.

Grass near paths and guardrails is often predicted as sidewalk, creating broad pink regions and displaced or spurious road interfaces. Town04-02 margin case visibly adds road/sidewalk-like regions over grass.

Wall label support in these selected wide views includes small/distant structures. Need focused GT overlays and matched training examples before assigning the failure solely to low resolution or any particular material.
Guardrails and occluding vehicles make visible interfaces more complex. The margin remains the supervised road-to-sidewalk/terrain interface, not a guaranteed physical curb or free-space boundary.
